name: trihex
description: High-performance Tri-Hex Metric Spatial Indexing Engine: Exact 1:4 Hierarchical Triangular Quadtree with Hexagonal Voronoi Dual and Network Topology Awareness

scripts.build: tsc && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/esm/index.js --packages=external && esbuild src/dispatch.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/esm/dispatch.js --packages=external && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=visualizer/trihex.js && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/esm/package.json', '{\"type\": \"module\"}')"
scripts.test: ts-node -T test/trihex.test.ts && ts-node -T test/trihex-enterprise.test.ts && ts-node -T test/trihex-audit-proofs.test.ts && ts-node -T test/trihex-dispatch.test.ts && ts-node -T test/trihex-adversarial-audit.ts && ts-node -T test/trihex-dual.test.ts && ts-node -T test/trihex-candidate-recall.test.ts && ts-node -T test/trihex-concurrency.test.ts && ts-node -T test/trihex-directed-edge.test.ts && ts-node -T test/trihex-hierarchical-polyfill.test.ts

author: Temitope Okunlola
